notes: Codex read-only review: 1 HIGH + 3 MEDIUM + 1 LOW, all accepted and fixed in 47b9685f before approval. HIGH: the comparator followed symlinks, so a deployed backup.sh symlinked into claude's checkout would hash the repo file and report 'match' — blessing precisely the #899 shape it exists to catch. Now O_NOFOLLOW + S_ISREG, with symlinks/directories inconclusive. MEDIUM: post-verification checked for a pointer the deploy never created ('enable --now' on a timer does not start its service), which would have failed the deploy after enabling and re-applied every tick (#891/#901); the entrypoint now seeds it with a real run. MEDIUM: write_state swallowed OSError, letting a stale success pointer persist while drift was known. MEDIUM: --state-path could target the protected directory. Codex verified correct: no writes to the protected directory, the health mapping against _explicit_error, the 0-or-1-but-not-2 gate, manifest schema validity, and the expected_baselines omission. make test 6239 / 0 failed.
